sampling.selection_rule: Existing frozen rank_in_cell <=16; no outcomes read or used in selection.

bootstrap.unit: whole paired problems; preserve all64draws; training-seed hierarchy for5seeds, fixed-seed conditional Pantry2seed inference

display.y_scale: linear; shared within domain; includes certified support reference
display.estimator: Exact rarefaction without replacement from each complete 64-response pool, then equal mean over all 16 prompts.
display.support_reference: Mean certified lower bound on existing modes; not an exhaustive count or exact coverage denominator.
display.intervals: Retained pointwise 95% paired whole-prompt bootstrap intervals; no simultaneous coverage claim.

limitations: No sampling or extrapolation beyond 64 responses.
Flattening within an observed finite pool does not establish asymptotic saturation.
All unsuccessful draws and zero-success prompts remain in the denominator.
Certified mode counts are lower bounds; unenumerated modes may also exist.
The strict analysis remains in the discovery-curve appendix.
